sourceEvidence.title: Senior Manager-Inventory Control
sourceEvidence.quote: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, Aerospace Operations, or a closely related business or technical field.

capture.text: Qualifications Required * Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, Aerospace Operations, or a closely related business or technical field. * At least 10 years of experience in materials management, warehouse management, supply chain management, or a similar role. This must include 8+ years of progressive leadership in warehouse operations and inventory management in aerospace, defense, or commercial space launch. * Proven experience bringing multiple functions or sites together into one organization with shared processes, metrics, and culture. * Proven experience managing a spread-out inventory network that includes central manufacturing hubs, remote field or launch sites, and fast-paced line-side or point-of-use (POU) replenishment cells. * Direct experience building, training, and managing a multi-shift team of warehouse managers, material control specialists, and logistics personnel under strict safety guidelines. * Strong knowledge of transportation, warehousing, trade compliance, order-to-cash processes, and inventory management principles, plus a deep understanding of logistics and order management best practices. * Experience setting up or managing quarantine/nonconforming material controls and GFE/CFE programs. * Hands-on experience managing age-sensitive materials (e.g., composites, epoxies, sealants), including storage temperature monitoring, out-time tracking, and cleanroom limits. * Proven experience owning budgets and building cost-tracking and reporting. * Skilled with ERP and Warehouse Management Systems, and with MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook). * Knowledge of industry standards, regulations, and best practices (e.g., AS9100, OSHA, ITAR/EAR, DOT/HAZMAT). * Able to work across functions and manage multiple projects at once, with strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills. * Able to travel as required, including to domestic and international launch sites. Desired * APICS/ASCM certification (CPIM or CSCP) and/or a Lean Six Sigma Green or Black Belt. * Knowledge of Odoo ERP/MRP. * ITAR experience, including domestic and international controlled shipments. * Familiarity with FAR 52.245-1 government property requirements and DCMA property audits. * Experience in an R&D-focused, prototyping, or test environment. * Experience leading warehouse expansion or new-facility projects. Pay information not provided on primary sources.
